402:t_000:10.en:
$$レド$$
「...Captain $$ガムリン$$ said something similar. I hear they eventually coexisted with monsters thought impossible to communicate with.」

402:t_000:11.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Can you hear me, $$レド$$, tin can? Past your current position is where the treasure is... in other words, their nest.」

402:t_000:12.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「They'll come out to defend the nest. I'm counting on you to kill them.」

402:t_000:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ colony is approaching.」

402:t_001:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I affirm that. However, I infer that I have the advantage in fighting strength. I judge that I can complete the mission alone.」

402:t_001:2.en:
$$レド$$
「This isn't $c's battle. It's the $$人類銀河同盟$$'s... my battle.」

402:t_002:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's go! We'll annihilate them here!」

402:t_003:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I confirm that the enemy colony has been annihilated.」

402:t_003:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't let your guard down. This probably wasn't all of them.」

402:t_003:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. I detect $$サイデリアル$$ approaching.」

402:t_004:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I detect an approaching energy mass.」

402:t_005:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. I detect $$サイデリアル$$ approaching.」

402:t_006:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I infer that $$サイデリアル$$'s targets are also Earth-type $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

402:t_006:1.en:
$$レド$$
「That doesn't mean we can fight alongside them.」

402:t_006:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Now that the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ are gone, they'll come for us.」

402:t_006:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I confirm the approach of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

402:t_007:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$レド$$! I don't recall authorizing you to deploy!」

402:t_007:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll hear your excuses later. First, we'll intercept $$サイデリアル$$.」

402:t_008:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Those corpses all around... Did $$レド$$ do this...?」

402:t_008:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「He has his own reasons. Let's not debate whether his actions were right or wrong here.」

402:t_008:4.en:
$n
「I'll do it, for everyone who helped me train.」

402:t_008:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「He seems a little more positive now.」

402:t_008:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「It seems his time alone helped him settle his feelings.」

402:t_008:7.en:
$n
(That girl, $$ティティ$$... I can't seem to stop thinking about her...)

402:t_008:8.en:
$n
(I heard she came from elsewhere, but why was she in the fleet...?)

402:t_008:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We are in the deep sea. Do not force an advance. Attack the enemies coming toward you first.」

402:t_008:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, I request your orders.」

402:t_008:11.en:
$$レド$$
「We'll intercept $$サイデリアル$$. Leaving them unchecked would endanger the $$ガルガンティア船団$$, too.」

402:t_009:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Those corpses all around... Did $$レド$$ do this...?」

402:t_009:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「He has his own reasons. Let's not debate whether his actions were right or wrong here.」

402:t_009:3.en:
$n
(That girl, $$ティティ$$... I can't seem to stop thinking about her...)

402:t_009:4.en:
$n
(I heard she came from elsewhere, but why was she in the fleet...?)

402:t_009:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We are in the deep sea. Do not force an advance. Attack the enemies coming toward you first.」

402:t_009:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, I request your orders.」

402:t_009:7.en:
$$レド$$
「We'll intercept $$サイデリアル$$. Leaving them unchecked would endanger the $$ガルガンティア船団$$, too.」

402:t_010:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I confirm that the enemy force has been wiped out.」

402:t_010:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It seems Ensign $$レド$$ has unexpectedly annihilated the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ in the $$残されの海$$.」

402:t_010:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And now that the survey force is gone, too, $$サイデリアル$$'s activities will likely stall.」

402:t_010:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$レド$$... I want an explanation.」

402:t_010:4.en:
$$レド$$
「With respect, Major $$オズマ$$, this unit's mission is not yet complete.」

402:t_010:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「His determination to annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ is greater than we imagined.」

402:t_010:8.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「What shall we do, Captain?」

402:t_010:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Any further intervention would also interfere with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$'s autonomy.」

402:t_010:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And since Ensign $$レド$$ is a willing volunteer, he has the right to refuse our orders.」

402:t_010:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, return. We will surface and hear from $$ピニオン$$ and Mr. $$フランジ$$.」

402:t_010:16.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Come back as soon as you can. It looked like $$エイミー$$... had been crying.」

402:t_011:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Our target is the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ nest.」

402:t_012:0.en:
$$レド$$
「We will continue the mission to annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

402:t_013:0.en:
$$レド$$
「At this rate, I can take on as many as they send...!」

402:t_013:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I affirm that. Earth-type $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ appear to be far weaker than the conventional type.」

402:t_013:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Their combat capability is approximately one-twentieth of mine. With my current armament, I can repel them continuously.」

402:t_013:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll do it...! I'll kill every last one!」

402:t_014:0.en:
$n
(I don't have Miss $$スズネ$$'s help... I must sharpen my own senses...!)

402:t_014:1.en:
$n
(Use no way as the way, and use the infinite as the finite...! I haven't surpassed my limits yet!)

402:t_100:0.en:
$$レド$$
($$エイミー$$, $$ベベル$$... I will annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$...)

402:t_100:1.en:
$$レド$$
(I may never be able to return to the fleet... Even so, I'll see this through...!)

402:t_101:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$サイデリアル$$...! I won't let you do as you please with this planet!」

402:t_102:0.en:
$n
(Come to think of it, I piloted the $$ジェニオン$$ alone at first...)

402:t_102:1.en:
$n
(I'll grow stronger to get Miss $$スズネ$$ back... To do that, I'll return to the basics...!)

402:t_103:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「All right! Let's do this, $$竜馬$$, $$隼人$$!」

402:t_103:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... It's been a while since we fought underwater.」

402:t_103:3.en:
$$弁慶$$
「The turn I've been waiting for is here! I'll send every last bastard who comes at us to a watery grave!」
